FullCalendar 6.1.22 — vendored JS distribution (calendar UI)
=============================================================

File:   index.global.min.js
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/fullcalendar/-/fullcalendar-6.1.22.tgz
        (package `fullcalendar`, "Standard Bundle" global build; upstream
        https://github.com/fullcalendar/fullcalendar)
Bytes:  285554  (upstream 285276 + 278-byte VENDORING banner added on top)
SHA256 (upstream file, pre-banner):
        65f927f1802cb35428b9c5e2a8d2276633880a89ee5ea5f9a7727f79892786ea

Vendored instead of linked from a CDN on purpose: the panel is a home-LAN /
localhost tool that must render with zero external requests (UI_UX_PLAN.md
§6.3, pinned by tests/test_ui_calendar.py). v6 injects its own CSS from the JS
bundle at runtime (the .fc-* stylesheets are inlined in the file and appended
as <style> elements — verified: `createElement("style")` present, no separate
CSS artifact needed).

Only the premium-free core views are used: dayGridMonth, timeGridWeek plus
the interaction + list plugins. License: MIT (Copyright (c) 2021 Adam Shaw) —
see LICENSE.md vendored next to the bundle. No premium plugins, no network
calls, no telemetry in the bundle.

Do not edit by hand; replace wholesale when bumping the pinned version and
update the hashes above, the banner, tests/test_ui_calendar.py and the
'UI slice' section of CALENDAR_DESIGN.md together.
